brief.headline: Push to ₹66.48/KG (the best price we already pay to Sayaji) and qualify a second source — we're overpaying ₹1.26 Cr/yr and relying too much on one supplier

priceAsk.basis: Sayaji Industries gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same material. Gujarat Ambuja charges ₹68.45/KG — 3.0% more. The market typical band is ₹66–73/kg, so ₹66.48/KG is fair and proven. We should pay one price across suppliers.

paymentTermAsk.summary: Move to payment on delivery (from 30 days after receipt)
paymentTermAsk.cashImpact: ₹1.74 Cr cash freed up for us

brief.financialLeverage: Gujarat Ambuja is a big, stable company (₹5995.63 Cr revenue) and keeps 8.5% of every sale as profit, so a small price cut won't hurt them. We're just 0.35% of their business, so we're not a must-keep account — but their healthy profit cushion (11.7% operating margin) means they can afford to match our best price. Their low debt (0.13x) and solid returns (12.5%) show no cash stress, so don't expect desperation — build the case on fairness and on lining up a credible second source.

evidence.point: We pay them ₹68.45/KG but Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose
They keep a comfortable profit — 8.5% of sales and 11.7% operating profit
We're a small customer to them
evidence.figure: Our ₹21.21 Cr is 0.35% of their ₹5995.63 Cr revenue

evidence.point: Market asking prices for Anhydrous Dextrose IP run ₹60–81/kg, typically ₹66–73/kg
They run low debt and strong returns

alternates.name: Gulshan Polyols Ltd
alternates.why: Listed starch and polyol maker, ₹2359.06 Cr revenue, health score B (62/100) — established dextrose supplier, a drop-in alternate

alternates.name: Sanstar Ltd
alternates.why: Recently-listed maize-derivatives specialist, ₹821.13 Cr revenue, health C (53/100) — growing dextrose capacity

alternates.name: Roquette India Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Indian arm of global starch major, ₹2898.05 Cr revenue — pharma-grade dextrose, premium and very reliable (a lead to qualify: verify before RFQ)

risks: Gujarat Ambuja supplies 56% of our Dextrose (₹21.21 Cr) — we don't have an approved second source yet, so pushing too hard before qualifying an alternate weakens our walk-away power
We're only 0.35% of their business, so they may walk if the ask feels unfair — anchor the price discussion to Sayaji's ₹66.48/KG, not a bigger cut
Faster payment (₹1.74 Cr cash freed up) is a big ask when their finances are already strong — tie it clearly to the price concession or phase it in
Their health score is C (55/100) — mid-range — so watch for any supply hiccups, but no red flags yet
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We value the partnership, but we're paying you ₹68.45/KG when Sayaji gives us ₹66.48/KG for the same Dextrose — let's find a way to get to one fair price across our suppliers.
